name: A Reliquary of Purity
summary: Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven asks you to seek a Reliquary of Purity in Southwind Village. Bring it back to him if you find it.

sections.title: A Search in Silithus
sections.body: From Nighthaven in Moonglade, Rabine Saturna sends you to Silithus. Search the ruins of Southwind Village for a Reliquary of Purity, then bring it back to him if you find it.

faq.q: Who sent me to find the reliquary?
faq.answer: Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven asks you to search for the Reliquary of Purity.

faq.q: Where should I look for the Reliquary of Purity?
faq.answer: Search for the Reliquary of Purity among the ruins of Southwind Village in Silithus.

faq.q: Where do I take the reliquary?
faq.answer: If you find the Reliquary of Purity, bring it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Reliquary of Purity
